Definition: from G575 and a derivative of G4721; to unroof:--uncover.
BiblicalUsage: When the crowd blocked the door, the four friends uncovered the roof above Jesus and let the paralysed man down through it. The word is that unroofing, the tearing open of a house to get a friend to Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: Faith that will not be stopped finds a way through the roof.
